Title: Dulwich: Symlink directory traversal in filter-branch index_filter via cross-commit state persistence
Description: Dulwich's `filter_branch.py` `CommitFilter._apply_index_filter()` is vulnerable to symlink directory traversal. When processing commit history, materialized tree entries (including symlinks) persist in the working directory between commits, allowing a symlink from an ancestor commit to redirect file writes from a descendant commit to arbitrary filesystem locations.
NotImpacted: All versions before 0.23.1, all versions starting from 1.2.8
